description: Defines the QuicChromiumClientStream class, a client-initiated reliable QUIC stream with associated handle class, including methods for headers, data, and connection management within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: QuicChromiumClientStream
classes.description: A client-initiated reliable QUIC stream class with methods for headers, data, and connection management.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A wrapper class for interacting with a QuicChromiumClientStream, providing methods for headers, data, and stream state management.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a new handle for this stream.

methods.name: ClearHandle
methods.description: Clears the handle associated with this stream.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Notifies the stream of an error without closing it.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, returning number of bytes read.

methods.name: DisableConnectionMigrationToCellularNetwork
methods.description: Prevents the stream from migrating to a cellular network.

methods.name: IsFirstStream
methods.description: Checks if this is the first data stream on the session.

methods.name: DeliverEarlyHints
methods.description: Delivers early hints headers to the handle.

methods.name: DeliverInitialHeaders
methods.description: Delivers initial headers to the handle.

methods.name: DeliverTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Delivers trailing headers to the handle.
